project.name: StorySketch
project.summary: Turns a written script into an editable, narrated whiteboard explainer video.

domains.name: Explainer creation
domains.summary: Plans, illustrates, narrates, and previews a whiteboard explainer.

domains.name: Project management
domains.summary: Preserves creator-owned drafts and restores them for later editing.

domains.name: Video export
domains.summary: Renders the current composition and makes the video available for download.

stories.title: Create a whiteboard explainer
stories.summary: Convert a script into editable scenes with selectable artwork, synchronized narration, and a full preview.

stories.title: Save and restore a project
stories.summary: Keep a creator's current draft available across editing sessions.

stories.title: Export a whiteboard video
stories.summary: Render the current project as a downloadable MP4 and retain the matching result.

steps.title: Script submitted
steps.summary: The creator starts a project with a title and non-empty script.

steps.title: Plan storyboard scenes
steps.summary: The script becomes an ordered set of titled scene drafts.

schemaChanges.description: The creator-visible title remains attached to the scene plan.
The source script is split into ordered scene drafts.

steps.title: Generate scene visuals
steps.summary: Each scene receives Minimal, Story, and Process artwork options that can animate as drawn strokes.

schemaChanges.description: Each scene receives three selectable visual interpretations.

steps.title: Generate scene narration
steps.summary: Each scene receives stored speech, timing alignment, and drawing strokes fitted to the narration duration.

schemaChanges.description: Each scene receives stored narration and timing metadata.
Character timing is retained for synchronized drawing.

steps.title: Explainer draft ready
steps.summary: The creator can review and adjust the complete scene sequence in the player.

steps.title: Owned projects requested
steps.summary: The signed-in creator opens the editor and requests saved projects.

steps.title: Project changed
steps.summary: An edit makes the current project different from its stored snapshot.

steps.title: Save project draft
steps.summary: After a short delay, the editor stores sanitized project and scene state for its owner.

schemaChanges.description: The sanitized editor snapshot becomes the persisted project draft.

steps.title: Project draft stored
steps.summary: The latest draft is available when the creator returns or switches projects.

steps.title: Video export requested
steps.summary: The creator submits the current composition with its project identity and render signature.

steps.title: Render project video
steps.summary: A remote sandbox composes the ordered scenes into an H.264 video while progress streams to the editor.

steps.title: Publish rendered video
steps.summary: The finished file is uploaded and its URL is saved only for the matching project version.

steps.title: Video export ready
steps.summary: The creator can download the completed video and retrieve it after refresh.

implementations.summary: Validate the script, request a scene plan, install the returned drafts, and start asset generation.
Prompt OpenRouter for structured scenes and validate the model response.
Request three SVG variations in parallel, normalize them, trace their shapes, and select one option.
Generate aligned speech, upload it, and scale drawing durations to the audio length.
Fetch projects owned by the session and return the most recently updated project as current.
Remove transient generation flags, enforce ownership, store current editor state, and clear stale render metadata.
Post the composition and read server-sent progress until completion or error.
implementations.needs: Composition props, project ID, and render signature

implementations.summary: Prepare a sandbox and render the Remotion composition with bounded concurrency.
Upload the sandbox file, persist matching render metadata, and send the completed URL.
implementations.produces: Public video URL and stored render record

sourceEvidence.supports: Defines Minimal, Story, and Process visual directions.
Loads the latest project or creates a first project.
Saves sanitized project state after a 1.2-second delay.
Generates all visual variations for scenes.
Generates narration and applies its duration to the selected artwork.
Plans scenes, installs drafts, and starts visual and audio generation together.
Uses OpenRouter to return a validated storyboard plan.
Uses OpenRouter to generate and normalize scene SVG artwork.
Uses ElevenLabs for timed speech and Vercel Blob for audio storage.
Converts supported SVG shapes into ordered timed strokes.
Scales drawing time to narration duration.
Builds the preview composition from current scene drafts.
Sequences prepared scenes into one composition.
Lists owned projects and creates starter projects.
Enforces ownership, stores drafts, and invalidates old render metadata.
Starts export and shows progress, errors, and download state.
Posts the render request and interprets streamed events.
Renders remotely, uploads the video, stores its metadata, and streams status.

diagnostics.message: The repository README describes the upstream Remotion template, so product behavior is derived from the current editor and API source.
Rare generation and render failures remain implementation diagnostics because they do not define a separate user outcome path.
